title: Cost-Accuracy Trade-offs: Neural Operator vs Classical Numerical Solver
abstract: arXiv:2609.24021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural operators are data-driven models that learn mappings from inputs that parameterize partial differential equations, such as spatially varying coefficients, initial conditions, forcing terms, boundary conditions, or geometries, to solution fields or quantities of interest. Once trained, they can serve as surrogates for classical numerical solvers in many-query settings that require repeated evaluations for varying inputs. We address the question of when, and then why, neural operator surrogates outperform classical numerical solvers, in terms of cost for a given accuracy. We focus on the post-training, many-query limit, in which data-acquisition and training costs are treated as fixed and fully amortized. Even in this deliberately favorable regime for neural operators, there are regimes in which classical solvers outperform the surrogate models. translated_title: 成本-精度权衡：神经算子与经典数值求解器的比较
translated_abstract: 神经算子是一类数据驱动模型，它们学习从参数化偏微分方程的输入（如空间变化的系数、初始条件、外力项、边界条件或几何形状）到解场或感兴趣量的映射。一旦训练完成，它们可以在需要针对不同输入进行重复评估的多查询场景中充当经典数值求解器的替代品。我们探讨了神经算子代理模型在何时以及为何在给定精度下的成本方面优于经典数值求解器的问题。我们聚焦于训练后、多查询的极限情况，其中数据获取和训练成本被视为固定的并已完全摊销。即使在这个对神经算子刻意有利的场景中，仍然存在经典求解器优于代理模型的情形。我们比较了神经算子代理模型与经典数值求解器在成本-精度方面的表现。
tldr: 该论文研究了在给定精度下神经算子代理模型与经典数值求解器的成本-精度权衡，发现在训练成本完全摊销的多查询场景中，即使对神经算子有利的条件下，经典求解器在某些情形下仍然更优。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the cost-accuracy trade-offs between neural operator surrogates and classical numerical solvers, showing that even in the deliberately favorable post-training many-query regime with fully amortized training costs, classical solvers can still outperform surrogate models in certain scenarios.
